reviewTiming: Findings and final disposition delivered to parent and author before their economic source freeze and campaign; this consolidated record is written afterward. No economic outcome had been inspected by this reviewer at writing.
reviewScope: Complete-cost pricing parity and matched human/conventional workflow
Source availability separate from technical conditional acceptance
Finite cash, invoices, defaults, accrued obligations and reserves
Seed excluded from available investment funds; historical recovery separate
Construction charged once; inherited prerequisites and finite useful life
Incremental rounded maintenance and conservative cash-rounding payback
Source/evidence/calibration binding and reproducible finite campaign dimensions

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Micro-USD CPU valuation could exceed integer-cent weekly billed savings
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: Separate conservative one-cent provision per active week in realized payback and per forecast week in investment gates; no positive attention or demand value invented

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Unavailable input cases could be misclassified as retryable delivered-output rejection
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: All planned cases retained; common source availability scenario precedes technical attempts; unavailable cases charge retrieval and triage without invoice or technical retry

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Machine capacity checked only service CPU, omitting acquisition/driver additions
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: Outer capacity includes common acquisition/driver and maximum available/blocked service cost; retries include their driver overhead

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Alternative choices could be mislabeled as fulfilled outputs despite common source limitations
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: Common unavailable opportunities recorded; competitor choices explicitly are not accepted deliveries

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Enterprise coarse tariff and continuous competitor markup created arbitrary pricing asymmetry
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: Equal AI uses the identical complete expected-collected-job cost and tariff grid; stronger efficiency/copying remains an explicit sensitivity condition

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Paid exact ties always selected the earlier AI option
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: Neutral common seeded draw among tied paid offers, with explicit free-DIY tie preference

preOutcomeCorrections.issue: Public DIY effort fraction accelerated a human baseline already defined as competent use of conventional tools
preOutcomeCorrections.resolution: Human-only and public-DIY durations now match; AI-assisted competitor remains separate

controls.reportingScope: isolated file-level result in this environment

controls.note: Explicit per-control output observed; process CPU for this additional invocation was not separately metered and is not assumed zero

lastRunnerChange.scope: Adds frozen Node runtime metadata/guard and a final recheck of every calibration evidence hash; no model, price, gate or ledger changes. Final runner reread independently.

limitations: This source review does not establish actual market demand, human effort, authoring/inference cost, willingness to pay, collected revenue or realized profit.
The 3/6 source-availability condition is the frozen experiment fraction used in a declared scenario, not a population frequency estimate.
Useful-life, demand, labor attention, maintenance, price and competitor behavior remain assumptions; executed resource use calibrates mechanical cost only.
Review recommendations were made from source and accounting logic before market outcomes, not by selecting favorable economic results.
